SET decide_frame_limit=3; SELECT id, x FROM (VALUES (1, 'A', 1, 4, 2), (2, 'A', 2, 6, 1), (3, 'A', 3, 1, 3), (4, 'B', 1, 7, 2), (5, 'B', 2, 3, 1)) t(id, product, period, v, w) DECIDE x(INT)
        SUCH THAT x <= sum(from first to last: t.v) over (ln(t.v - 2)) MAXIMIZE sum(x)
